prerequisites: No prerequisites. Competences taught in the advanced modules for Theoretical Computer Science are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: explain fundamental techniques for the formal description of programming language syntax and semantics
apply these to formally describe their own small programming languages
report on research results from current scientific contributions in national and international journals and conferences in the field of programming language design
apply scientific working methods in independently identifying, formulating, and solving problems
speak freely about scientific content, both in front of an audience and in a discussion

syllabus_topics: Contents of recent research in programming concepts. The specific technical orientation of the module is determined by the lecturer.

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions to at least two exercises

assessment_rules: To acquire the credit points, students must achieve at least 50% of the points from the weekly exercises and orally present the solution to at least two exercises. The final examination is either an individual oral examination or a written examination. Grading is based on a scale of 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science degree program.
